title: Smooth exterior self-similar profiles near the singular supercritical wave profile with weighted and parameter bounds
author: Kim, Jihoi
work: On self-similar blow up for the energy supercritical semilinear wave equation
difficulty_reason: The construction requires an exterior resolvent that remains controlled across the singular light cone and simultaneously at the origin and infinity in distinct weighted norms. Its new local core computes fundamental-solution asymptotics and proves nonlinear Lipschitz estimates strong enough to construct the profile, its scaling derivative, and its parameter derivative. Banach contraction alone does not supply those singular weighted estimates or the smoothness argument across the light cone; the entire authored construction is retained and exceeds ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
